name: crossbeam-delivery-pause
instr:
Please add a shared delivery pause to crossbeam-channel in `/app`, so consumers can hold incoming work without discarding it or closing the channel. Add these inherent methods on `crossbeam_channel::Receiver<T>`: `Receiver::pause(&self) -> bool`, `Receiver::resume(&self) -> bool`, and `Receiver::is_paused(&self) -> bool`, all public. Channels start unpaused. `pause` and `resume` return whether they changed the state, which is shared by all receiver clones. For timer and never receivers, all three methods return `false` and have no effect. Don't add new crates.

While paused, no new receive reservation may take a message. Buffered sends can still fill available space, and length, capacity, empty and full queries describe the actual buffer. A zero-capacity channel cannot pair a send with a receive while paused. Receive operations, selection and readiness must treat held messages as unavailable; nonblocking receives report `TryRecvError::Empty`, and timed operations can time out normally. Resuming makes held messages available in FIFO order and wakes operations waiting for delivery or rendezvous. A send or receive reservation already selected before pausing can still complete.

Disconnection does not release held messages: a paused nonempty buffer remains unavailable until resumed. An empty disconnected channel still reports disconnection, even while paused.

Also add `Receiver::pause_scoped(&self)`, returning an optional owned guard implementing `Drop` and `Send` when `T: Send`
